sites.contract_kind: # Safety fn contract (added; fn had no doc)
sites.contract: No caller-independent precondition: no arguments, no caller pointer dereferenced; the sole unsafe call (raise_site_dynamic) is discharged internally by the constant CORE_NAMEMAP_288 site and reason.

Sentinel freefunc: may only be installed in the stack-built QUERY key whose callbacks the store never invokes; _method is never dereferenced (any value, including NULL/dangling, is inert) and the body aborts at the extern-C boundary rather than unwinding. ABI: void (*)(void *).
preconditions: installed only as the QUERY key's method.free, which the store never calls
ABI void (*)(void *)

preconditions: symbol resolves to libc abort with the <stdlib.h> signature

sites.operation: unsafe extern "C" { fn nanosleep(req: *const Timespec, rem: *mut Timespec) -> c_int; }
sites.contract_kind: SAFETY: comment on unsafe extern block (added)
sites.contract: libc nanosleep; Timespec is #[repr(C)] with c_long fields so it has the libc layout. req must be non-NULL, aligned, initialised and readable for the call; rem must be NULL (the crate passes NULL) or aligned and writable. Reads only *req, writes only *rem; int return is errno, not a pointer.
preconditions: req: non-NULL, aligned, initialised, readable *const struct timespec
rem: NULL or aligned, writable *mut struct timespec
symbol resolves to libc nanosleep with the <time.h> signature

Frees each slot and the array exactly once and clears both fields.

sites.contract: ABI: security callback int (*)(const SSL *, const SSL_CTX *, int, int, int, void *, void *). s may be NULL; non-NULL s must be live and initialised (SSL_is_dtls dereferences it in the VERSION arm). ctx may be NULL; non-NULL ctx must be live with a non-NULL, live cert container (SSL_CTX_get_security_level dereferences it unchecked). No concurrent mutation; _other/_ex are never read (any value).
preconditions: non-NULL s: live, initialised connection
non-NULL ctx: live context with non-NULL live cert
no concurrent mutation of s/ctx
ABI security callback

sites.contract: No caller-independent precondition on argument values: _ctx, scts and _arg are never read (empty SCT model; only the SSL_R_NO_VALID_SCTS raise and 0 remain), so NULL/dangling/unaligned values are inert. Only the ABI applies: int (*)(void *, void *, void *).
preconditions: ABI CT validation callback int (*)(void *, void *, void *)

sites.operation: serverinfo_srv_add_cb(s, ext_type, out, outlen, al, arg)
sites.contract: No caller-independent precondition on pointer values: the body forwards to serverinfoex_srv_add_cb, which ignores _s/_out/_outlen/_al/_arg and returns 0, so none is dereferenced and NULL/dangling/unaligned values are inert. Only the ABI applies: custom-extension add callback int (*)(SSL *, unsigned int, const unsigned char **, size_t *, int *, void *).
preconditions: ABI custom-extension add callback

sites.contract_kind: # Safety fn contract (added; fn had no doc)
sites.contract: s non-NULL, aligned, live, fully initialised and exclusively accessible. The driver re-enters the application certificate hook (invoke_cert_cb) at the CertificateRequest/TLS_ST_CW_CERT transition, and that hook may mutate s, so the caller must hold no Rust reference (shared or exclusive) into s across the call; cert, rbio/wbio and transcript fields must satisfy the connection invariants on entry.
preconditions: s: non-NULL, aligned, live, initialised, exclusive
no Rust reference into s held across the call (application cert hook may mutate it)
connection fields satisfy crate invariants on entry

sites.contract_kind: # Safety fn contract (added; fn had no doc)
sites.contract: s non-NULL, aligned, live, initialised and exclusive. Non-NULL ext_ocsp_resp must be the base of a CRYPTO_* seam allocation holding exactly ext_ocsp_resp_len readable initialised bytes, owned by s and not concurrently freed/mutated. NULL/zero length is a no-op; length > 0xff_ffff is refused; the bytes are copied into a frame buffer and not retained.
preconditions: s: non-NULL, aligned, live, initialised, exclusive
ext_ocsp_resp: NULL or CRYPTO_* allocation of exactly ext_ocsp_resp_len readable initialised bytes, owned by s, not concurrently mutated

sites.contract: p NULL or the base of an OSSL_STORE_INFO_new* allocation from the CRYPTO_* seam at the authority's size/file/line, aligned for OsslStoreInfo, fully initialised and exclusively owned by the freeing stack (not already released). Ownership transfers to OSSL_STORE_INFO_free; p must not be used afterwards. ABI: OPENSSL_sk_freefunc void (*)(void *).
preconditions: p: NULL or CRYPTO_* allocation of an initialised OSSL_STORE_INFO, exclusively owned, unreleased
ownership transfers to OSSL_STORE_INFO_free
ABI OPENSSL_sk_freefunc
